To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Menter SST k-ω turbulence model is the most suitable model to simulate compressible flows over complex geometries with unstructured grids.

the Menter SST k- ω model was the most accurate and stable model for all the cases considered, and that the Spalart-Allmaras model was the most unstable one, particularly for the case of the F15 aircraft configuration.

the Spalart-Allmaras model is not suitable for compressible flows, the Wilcox model is suitable for attached flows but not for separated flows with recircularization, and that the Menter SST turbulence model is the most suitable for both attached and separated flows.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the assessment of different turbulence models for steady, compressible flows around complex geometries with unstructured grids.
the assessment of several turbulence models for the simulation of compressible flows around complex geometries with unstructured grids.
a numerical assessment of turbulence models for steady RANS simulations of compressible flows around complex geometries with unstructured grids.

the Menter SST turbulence model was the best model for the simulation of the flow over complex geometries with unstructured grids, for the cases investigated in this study.
the Menter SST turbulence model should be used in all cases.
the Spalart-Allmaras and the Menter SST models are recommended for the simulation of compressible, turbulent flows around complex geometries with unstructured grids.

the Menter SST k- ω turbulence model is the most reliable for compressible flows on unstructured grids, especially for flows with recirculating zones.
the Menter SST turbulence model was the best choice for the simulation of complex, compressible flows with unstructured grids.

the Menter SST turbulence model should be the preferred choice for the simulation of high Reynolds number, compressible flows on complex geometries.
